mapper.select:
/* ServiceRequestMapper.findAdminServiceRequestPage */ SELECT s.SVC_REQ_SN, s.SVC_REQ_TTL, s.CAT_SN, category.CAT_NM, s.USR_SN, requester.USR_NM, s.SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD, status_code.CMM_NM AS SVC_REQ_STATUS_NM, s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN, s.SVC_REQ_REG_DT, s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT
ORDER BY CASE s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD WHEN 'SVCC0002' THEN 0 WHEN 'SVCC0001' THEN 1 WHEN 'SVCC0003' THEN 2 WHEN 'SVCC0004' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END ASC, s.SVC_REQ_REG_DT DESC, s.SVC_REQ_SN DESC LIMIT #{condition.size} OFFSET #{condition.offset}

/* ServiceRequestMapper.findAdminServiceRequestDetail */ SELECT s.SVC_REQ_SN, s.SVC_REQ_TTL, s.SVC_REQ_CN, s.CAT_SN, category.CAT_NM, s.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, s.USR_SN, requester.USR_NM, s.SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD, status_code.CMM_NM AS SVC_REQ_STATUS_NM, s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN, s.SVC_REQ_REG_DT, s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT FROM SERVICE_REQUEST s JOIN CATEGORY category ON category.CAT_SN = s.CAT_SN JOIN USERS requester ON requester.USR_SN = s.USR_SN JOIN CMM_CODE status_code ON status_code.CMM_CD = s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD WHERE s.SVC_REQ_SN = #{serviceRequestId}
mapper.insert: /* ServiceRequestMapper.saveServiceRequest */ INSERT INTO SERVICE_REQUEST (USR_SN, CAT_SN, SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, SVC_REQ_TTL, SVC_REQ_CN, SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD, SVC_REQ_REG_ID, SVC_REQ_UPDT_ID) VALUES (#{usrSn}, #{catSn}, #{formTemplateSn}, #{svcReqTtl}, #{svcReqCn}, #{svcReqBdgtAmt}, #{svcReqStatusCd}, #{svcReqRegId}, #{svcReqUpdtId})
mapper.select: /* ServiceRequestMapper.findServiceRequestById */ SELECT s.SVC_REQ_SN, s.USR_SN, s.CAT_SN, s.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, c.CAT_NM, s.SVC_REQ_TTL, s.SVC_REQ_CN, s.SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD, s.SVC_REQ_REG_DT, s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT FROM SERVICE_REQUEST s JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = s.CAT_SN WHERE s.SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} AND s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT s.SVC_REQ_SN, s.USR_SN, s.CAT_SN, s.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, c.CAT_NM, s.SVC_REQ_TTL, s.SVC_REQ_CN, s.SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD, s.SVC_REQ_REG_DT, s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT FROM SERVICE_REQUEST s JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = s.CAT_SN WHERE s.SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn}

/* ServiceRequestMapper.findPublicServiceRequestById */ SELECT s.SVC_REQ_SN, s.USR_SN, s.CAT_SN, s.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, c.CAT_NM, s.SVC_REQ_TTL, s.SVC_REQ_CN, s.SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD, s.SVC_REQ_REG_DT, s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT FROM SERVICE_REQUEST s JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = s.CAT_SN WHERE s.SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0002' AND s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y'

/* ServiceRequestMapper.findMyServiceRequests */ SELECT s.SVC_REQ_SN, s.USR_SN, s.CAT_SN, s.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, c.CAT_NM, s.SVC_REQ_TTL, s.SVC_REQ_CN, s.SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT, s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD, s.SVC_REQ_REG_DT, s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT, (SELECT CONCAT('/api/service-requests/', s.SVC_REQ_SN, '/images/', i.FL_SN) FROM SVC_REQ_IMAGE i JOIN FILES f ON f.FL_SN = i.FL_SN AND f.FL_USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE i.SVC_REQ_SN = s.SVC_REQ_SN ORDER BY i.SVC_REQ_IMG_SORT_NO ASC LIMIT 1) AS REP_IMAGE_URL, COALESCE(quoteCount.QUOTE_CNT, 0) AS QUOTE_CNT FROM SERVICE_REQUEST s JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = s.CAT_SN LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SVC_REQ_SN, COUNT(*) AS QUOTE_CNT FROM QUOTE GROUP BY SVC_REQ_SN ) quoteCount ON quoteCount.SVC_REQ_SN = s.SVC_REQ_SN WHERE s.USR_SN = #{usrSn} AND s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y'
AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0001'
AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0002'
AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0003'
AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0004'
ORDER BY s.SVC_REQ_REG_DT DESC
mapper.update: /* ServiceRequestMapper.updateServiceRequest */ UPDATE SERVICE_REQUEST SET CAT_SN = #{catSn}, SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = #{formTemplateSn}, SVC_REQ_TTL = #{svcReqTtl}, SVC_REQ_CN = #{svcReqCn}, SVC_REQ_BDGT_AMT = #{svcReqBdgtAmt}, SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = #{svcReqStatusCd}, SVC_REQ_UPDT_ID = #{svcReqUpdtId}, SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} AND USR_SN = #{usrSn} AND SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0001' AND SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y'

UPDATE SERVICE_REQUEST SET SVC_REQ_USE_YN = #{targetUseYn}, SVC_REQ_UPDT_ID = #{updtId}, SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} AND SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0002' AND SVC_REQ_USE_YN = #{expectedUseYn}
mapper.select: SELECT s.SVC_REQ_SN AS serviceRequestId, s.USR_SN AS ownerUserSn, s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, ( SELECT t.TRD_SN FROM TRADE t WHERE t.SVC_REQ_SN = s.SVC_REQ_SN ORDER BY t.TRD_SN DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS linkedTradeSn, ( SELECT t.TRD_STATUS_CD FROM TRADE t WHERE t.SVC_REQ_SN = s.SVC_REQ_SN ORDER BY t.TRD_SN DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS linkedTradeStatusCode, CASE WHEN s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0002' THEN COALESCE( s.SVC_REQ_DEADLINE_DT, LEAST( DATE_ADD(s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT, INTERVAL 5 DAY), COALESCE( ( SELECT MIN(DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE(i.SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_CN, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM i JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF f ON f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = i.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN WHERE i.SVC_REQ_SN = s.SVC_REQ_SN AND f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD = 'CALENDAR' ), DATE_ADD(s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT, INTERVAL 5 DAY) ) ) ) ELSE NULL END AS effectiveDeadlineAt, NOW() AS databaseNow FROM SERVICE_REQUEST s WHERE s.USR_SN = #{userSn} AND s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y' AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD IN ( 'SVCC0001', 'SVCC0002', 'SVCC0003', 'SVCC0005' ) ORDER BY s.SVC_REQ_SN FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.SVC_REQ_SN AS serviceRequestId, s.USR_SN AS ownerUserSn, s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, CASE WHEN s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0002' THEN COALESCE( s.SVC_REQ_DEADLINE_DT, LEAST( DATE_ADD(s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT, INTERVAL 5 DAY), COALESCE( ( SELECT MIN(DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE(i.SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_CN, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM i JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF f ON f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = i.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN WHERE i.SVC_REQ_SN = s.SVC_REQ_SN AND f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD = 'CALENDAR' ), DATE_ADD(s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT, INTERVAL 5 DAY) ) ) ) ELSE NULL END AS effectiveDeadlineAt, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS databaseNow FROM SERVICE_REQUEST s WHERE s.SVC_REQ_SN = #{serviceRequestId} AND s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE SERVICE_REQUEST SET SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0005', SVC_REQ_UPDT_ID = #{actorId}, SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SVC_REQ_SN = #{serviceRequestId} AND SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = #{expectedStatusCode} AND SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD IN ('SVCC0001', 'SVCC0002', 'SVCC0003') AND SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y'

UPDATE SERVICE_REQUEST SET SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = #{statusCode}, SVC_REQ_DEADLINE_DT = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'SVCC0002' THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL GREATEST(COALESCE(#{remainingSeconds}, 0), 1) SECOND) ELSE SVC_REQ_DEADLINE_DT END, SVC_REQ_UPDT_ID = #{actorId}, SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SVC_REQ_SN = #{serviceRequestId} AND SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0005' AND SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y'

UPDATE SERVICE_REQUEST SET SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0004', SVC_REQ_UPDT_ID = #{actorId}, SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SVC_REQ_SN = #{serviceRequestId} AND SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0001' AND SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y'

UPDATE SERVICE_REQUEST s SET SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0004', SVC_REQ_UPDT_ID = #{actorId}, SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE s.SVC_REQ_SN = #{serviceRequestId} AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = #{expectedStatusCode} AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD IN ('SVCC0003', 'SVCC0005') AND s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRADE t WHERE t.SVC_REQ_SN = s.SVC_REQ_SN AND t.TRD_STATUS_CD != 'TRDC0008' )

UPDATE SERVICE_REQUEST s SET SVC_REQ_DEADLINE_DT = LEAST( DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 DAY), COALESCE( ( SELECT MIN(DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE(i.SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_CN, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM i JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF f ON f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = i.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN WHERE i.SVC_REQ_SN = s.SVC_REQ_SN AND f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD = 'CALENDAR' ), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 DAY) ) ) WHERE s.SVC_REQ_SN = #{serviceRequestId} AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0002' AND s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: /* ServiceRequestMapper.findExpiredOpenServiceRequestIds */ SELECT s.SVC_REQ_SN FROM SERVICE_REQUEST s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.SVC_REQ_SN, MIN(DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(i.SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_CN, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS PREF_DT FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM i JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF f ON f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = i.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN WHERE f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD = 'CALENDAR' GROUP BY i.SVC_REQ_SN ) pref ON pref.SVC_REQ_SN = s.SVC_REQ_SN WHERE s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0002' AND s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE( s.SVC_REQ_DEADLINE_DT, LEAST( DATE_ADD(s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT, INTERVAL 5 DAY), COALESCE(pref.PREF_DT, DATE_ADD(s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT, INTERVAL 5 DAY)) ) ) <= NOW() ORDER BY s.SVC_REQ_SN LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SERVICE_REQUEST s WHERE s.SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0002' AND s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE( s.SVC_REQ_DEADLINE_DT, LEAST( DATE_ADD(s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT, INTERVAL 5 DAY), COALESCE( ( SELECT MIN(DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE(i.SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_CN, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM i JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF f ON f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = i.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN WHERE i.SVC_REQ_SN = s.SVC_REQ_SN AND f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD = 'CALENDAR' ), DATE_ADD(s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT, INTERVAL 5 DAY) ) ) ) > NOW()
mapper.update: /* ServiceRequestMapper.autoCloseServiceRequest */ UPDATE SERVICE_REQUEST s SET SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0004', SVC_REQ_UPDT_ID = 'SYSTEM' WHERE s.SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} AND s.SVC_REQ_STATUS_CD = 'SVCC0002' AND s.SVC_REQ_USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE( s.SVC_REQ_DEADLINE_DT, LEAST( DATE_ADD(s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT, INTERVAL 5 DAY), COALESCE( ( SELECT MIN(DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE(i.SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_CN, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM i JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF f ON f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = i.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN WHERE i.SVC_REQ_SN = s.SVC_REQ_SN AND f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD = 'CALENDAR' ), DATE_ADD(s.SVC_REQ_UPDT_DT, INTERVAL 5 DAY) ) ) ) <= NOW()
